description: The plot illustrates the loss over training time for two different methods, Vanilla and SepLLM, in the context of accelerating large language models by compressing one segment into one separator. The x-axis represents the training time in seconds, ranging from 0 to 250,000 seconds, with tick labels at intervals of 50,000 seconds. The y-axis represents the loss, with values ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, and tick labels at intervals of 0.05.
